name: longform-batch-delivery
whatsNew: v11.0.0 adds the M0 "NO-STOP" rule: until run_state.py gate exits 0 you must NEVER emit a message without a tool call. Forbidden endings (progress tables, "shall I continue?", any question waiting for input, wrap-up phrases, pasting prose into chat) all end the turn and hand control back to the user - that is the real reason "the skill ran one round and stopped" (it is NOT the 25-step pause; that is an in-turn checkpoint and is already off under Full Access). New _selftest/loop_guard.py self-check and templates/NO_STOP.md card. gate stays the only legal definition of done: 0=DONE / 1=keep writing / 2=fix first.
